title: Streetly Hampden Memorial
location_name: All Saints Church, Streetly, Sutton Coldfield, West Midlands
memorial_details: Inscribed pew end to Sgt J.G. Procter inside All Saints Church, Streetly, Sutton Coldfield.
narrative: Hampden AD839 of 50 Squadron, coded VN-L, was lost on 30 August 1941. The aircraft crashed near Abbeville, France. All four crew were killed. Sgt J.G. Procter of Streetly is commemorated on an inscribed pew end in All Saints Church.

sources.title: Chorley, W.R. — Bomber Command Losses Vol. 2
Tony Hibberd (RAF Bomber Command Memorials Facebook group, admin post)
